fusions.name: Knothole Glance
fusions.desc: A stare from a knot in your bark that deals 4 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Lenticel Stare
fusions.desc: Opens every pore in your bark: it deals 26 arcane damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignores resistances and leaves each one [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Watch-Sapling
fusions.desc: Plants a sapling that watches for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Unwitnessed
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
